submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) provides the highest signal efficiency at all simulated thresholds, including at the 8 kHz trigger rate allocation. Simulation at 40 GeV threshold yields 91.9% efficiency, which is significantly higher than alternatives. Candidate and simulation documentation confirm suitability and hardware compatibility.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L2 is explicitly listed among the three candidates (candidate_specs.md).

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.
requirements.evidence: All candidates, including Algorithm-L2, are stated to fit within resource budgets (candidate_specs.md).
The selected threshold, 40 GeV, is directly within the specified range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: This submission recommends Algorithm-L2 at a 40 GeV threshold.
